pattern: Grid list (as in the React Aria TagGroup): role=grid with one row per tag and one gridcell per row; roving tabindex over the rows.

aria.value: true or false when selection is enabled; absent otherwise

keyboard.action: Moves into the group (to the last focused tag) and out of it.
Move to the next or previous enabled tag (reading direction aware).
Remove the tag; focus moves to the next tag, or the previous one at the end.

focus: One tag in the tab sequence; after a removal, focus moves to the tag that took its place (or the previous tag).
notes: Removals are announced ('{label} removed') through the polite live region.
Selected tags differ in more than hue (selection fill and a stronger boundary).
knownCaveats: Grid semantics are announced differently by screen readers; manual verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
